records.title: Growing demand for Urea in Telangana
details:
(a) whether Government has any policy to accord priority to the allocation of Urea produced by Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited (RFCL), Telangana, for meeting the requirements of Telangana before allocating it to other States, if so, the details thereof; and
(b) whether Government proposes to enhance the production capacity of RFCL to meet the growing demand for Urea in Telangana, if so, the details thereof?
